material_news_signals.headline: Colts vs. Commanders: Three must-know storylines for NFL Week 4 London game
material_news_signals.description: Can Indianapolis star Jonathan Taylor break out of his early-season slump? Will Marcus Mariota lead Washington to a second straight win in relief of Jayden Daniels? Jeremy Bergman provides three must-know storylines for Sunday's Colts-Commanders game in London.
material_news_signals.body_text: the european leg of the nfl s 2026 world tour kicks off this weekend in the league s most familiar foreign locale after stops in oceania and south america london is the setting for sunday morning football for the next three weeks starting with this week s colts commanders clash at tottenham hotspur stadium two of the nfl s older franchises indianapolis 1953 and washington 1932 are no strangers to the new reality of annual international football in fact both teams broke ground last season on the european continent the colts played in and won the nfl s first ever game played in berlin while the commanders participated in but lost the league s first game in spain played at madrid s bernabeu both indy and d c got off the schneid last week improving to 1 2 with surprising victories over 2025 playoff teams this sunday washington will look to break another ignominious streak winning its first international game in four tries the commanders are the only nfl franchise to play in at least three international games and not have a win 0 2 1 can the capital s club capitalize on its first win of the season with another in england or will jonathan taylor and co run over the competition overseas yet again three must know storylines 1 can taylor finally break out of early season slump jonathan taylor is as reggie jackson once coined himself the straw that stirs the drink he makes indy s offense go and has done so for the past six seasons this year he s tied for the league lead in rushing attempts through three games 66 but he s off to a career worst start in terms of efficiency taylor is averaging fewer than 4 rushing yards per attempt and has yet to record 100 ground yards in a game this season plus he s coming off the worst of his three efforts a 68 yard td less game in week 3 s slim win over houston standing in his way in week 4 a washington unit that has been surprisingly stout in run defense allowing just 246 yards through three weeks third in nfl at 3 8 yards per carry the commanders are tops in the league in run stuff percentage 25 and have allowed just five runs of 10 plus yards tied for third per next gen stats taylor was a horse in the colts international outing last season posting 244 rushing yards and 286 yards from scrimmage both international records per nfl research in indy s overtime victory over atlanta at olympiastadion with 78 rushing yards against washington taylor will be the all time leading rusher in international games in nfl history as daniel jones works his way back into form and the colts deal with health issues for wideouts alec pierce keenan allen and ashton dulin taylor needs to bring that horsepower again or indy won t be able to keep pace with jacksonville in the afc south 2 commanders sans starting qb in europe again washington is playing its second international game in as many years without its star quarterback under center after jayden daniels missed last year s madrid game with a dislocated elbow the nfl scheduled the commanders for a week 4 international bout surely the 2024 offensive rookie of the year would be healthy for that lone window slot nope daniels was ruled out for the second straight game on friday after dislocating the same left elbow in week 2 the commanders qb has foregone surgery and a stint on injured reserve and was limited in practices this week in london washington coach dan quinn said daniels return to practice was a big step that ll be little solace to the english fans who were eager to get a glimpse of the star signal caller in action on sunday lucky for washington it has an ace second stringer in fellow former no 2 pick marcus mariota the flyin hawaiian arrived in the united kingdom on a high this week after posting a throwback performance in the commanders week 3 upset of the reigning super bowl champion seahawks last sunday mariota enjoyed his first three td zero int 110 0 plus passer rating game since week 8 of 2022 and salted away the victory with a clutch read option run it was vintage stuff will it translate to week 4 against a league worst colts defense 417 3 total yards per game allowed albeit one that shut down houston last week or will a second consecutive game without daniels lead to another international defeat with mariota under center 3 can receivers take advantage of struggling dbs in a matchup featuring two down defenses it s paramount for each offense to identify areas of vulnerability to attack those soft spots lie in the secondaries of both ds meaning the offenses will aim to exploit advantages with their receivers the colts will be looking to new wr1 josh downs who took up the mantle left by the injured alec pierce and departed michael pittman downs has averaged a team high 2 4 yards per route on a 32 8 target rate in weeks 2 and 3 while the colts have mostly been without pierce and ranks 15th among qualified receivers in receiving expected points added 12 6 just below justin jefferson per next gen stats indy will hope to get him in positions against mike sainristil who has allowed a league high five touchdowns and a 142 4 passer rating when targeted through three weeks his defensive back mates jeremy reaves 154 6 rating 42 8 croe and quan martin 28 croe have fared no better opening up opportunities for tight end tyler warren meanwhile washington will look to exploit justin walley in the slot the colts primary nickelback has allowed 13 receptions on 15 targets for 213 yards and two tds in the slot the most yards allowed by any defender and 84 more than the next closest cb opponents have recorded a perfect 158 3 passer rating when targeting walley in those matchups per next gen stats that could spell a big day for the commanders top three receivers two time pro bowler terry mclaurin who s looking for his first 100 yard game in 2026 but is questionable with a balky hamstring rookie antonio williams who boasts a team high 27 2 croe and 8 7 receiving epa when targeted in the slot and veteran stefon diggs who has run a team high 44 routes out of the slot this season editor s update mclaurin is inactive for sunday s game

running game struggles in the first half saying 17 yards were 34 not good enough got to be better 34 as he did kubiak raised his head to look at a scoreboard showing a three point lead for the las vegas raiders over the kansas city chiefs 34 but you know what we 39 re winning 34 kubiak followed 34 we 39 re gonna win the game 34 the statement was as bold as they come from the first year head coach patrick mahomes had never lost in allegiant stadium the raiders were in just their fourth game removed from a league worst season a year ago facing a chiefs roster well versed in winning close games against quality opponents but kubiak should have been proven right the raiders were going to win until they didn 39 t las vegas looked like the superior team for the better part of their 30 27 loss to the chiefs its first with kubiak at the helm despite a sluggish rushing attack their passing offense was getting the better of veteran kansas city defensive coordinator steve spagnuolo 39 s unit and the raiders 39 defense had mahomes as uncomfortable as he 39 s been this season the game slipped away due to a few shaky moments in execution by the players but also in three decisions by kubiak and his coaching staff 34 wish we would have won the game 34 kubiak said postgame 34 we 39 ve got a lot of hardworking guys that care about winning and fell short tonight 34 the game 39 s first inflection point came on the opening drive of the third quarter with the raiders leading 13 10 after 41 yards on three touches from running back ashton jeanty put the raiders deep in kansas city territory the drive stalled matt gay came on and connected on a 41 yard field goal but the chiefs were flagged for an illegal formation on the kick kubiak chose to take the points off the board instead setting up a fourth and 2 at the chiefs 39 18 34 we were going to be aggressive going into the game 34 kubiak said of his mindset in the situation 34 i don 39 t regret it 34 the drive 39 s rather than pumping to receiver cody white 34 that 39 s one of the plays i 39 ll be driving home kind of thinking about 34 cousins said kubiak said the aggression was planned and analytics and circumstance made it warranted it didn 39 t hurt the head coach in the moment either as his defense continued to torment mahomes and forced a punt on the ensuing drive in retrospect the decision only became peculiar when kubiak took a much different tack one quarter later the raiders 39 second possession of the fourth quarter starting with a little less than 10 minutes left had many similarities to the third quarter drive jeanty helped get them into kansas city territory only for the offense stall jeanty was stood up for no gain on a third and 2 at the chiefs 39 30 the biggest difference was the score the raiders were now trailing 17 16 cousins and the offense stayed on the field for a beat before fourth down seemingly ready for kubiak 39 s play call a moment later the field goal unit was coming on kubiak needed to be refreshed on the situations when asked why two similar scenarios elicited opposite decisions his response was brief upon resonation 34 just wanted points 34 kubiak said 34 fell short the first time wanted to get points 34 if aggression was the game plan kubiak 39 s answer showed that he deviated from it perhaps in reaction to the previous result it 39 s hard to fault him for either decision individually but the incongruency can 39 t be ignored the defense returned to the field to protect a one point lead with less than five minutes to go it was third and 5 for mahomes at his own 40 when the pendulum seemed to swing back to aggression for the raiders 39 staff defensive coordinator rob leonard dialed up a nickel blitz it was an audacious call las vegas the next play 34 we were gonna be aggressive for the game 34 kubiak said of the call 34 sometimes you win in those situations sometimes you go the other way that 39 s part of being a competitor and doing what you feel is right in the moment 34 the raiders preached aggressiveness like they were ready to deal with any consequences for the most part they were and kubiak owned up to them executional stopped everything moved too quickly cousins rushed to the line with the play clock ticking down in the chaos several players weren 39 t set the raiders were flagged for an illegal shift and neither was the protection there was a jumbled mess of receivers downfield all covered the result chiefs edge rusher george karlaftis hit cousins 39 arm as he threw and the pass was intercepted 34 i didn 39 t material_news_signals.body_text: with the 2026 nfl trade deadline set for nov 10 nfl com breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of trade sept 28 new york receives qb j j mccarthy grade c minnesota receives 2027 fifth round draft pick grade c minnesota signaled its intent to move on from the former no 10 overall pick by inking kyler murray and bringing back carson wentz in the offseason mccarthy got a slim shot at the starting job during training camp but he couldn t even fend off wentz for the primary backup role a former first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york

material_news_signals.headline: Commanders QB Marcus Mariota suffers knee injury in loss to Colts
material_news_signals.description: Marcus Mariota was ruled out of Sunday's game against the Colts after suffering a right knee injury in the first quarter. Mariota was replaced by seventh-round rookie Athan Kaliakmanis.
material_news_signals.body_text: the commanders quarterback quandary has grown even more precarious backup qb marcus mariota did not return to sunday s 30 13 loss to the colts in london after suffering a right knee injury in the first quarter mariota was replaced by seventh round rookie athan kaliakmanis and ruled out at halftime mariota was playing in place of washington starter jayden daniels who has been sidelined the last two weeks after dislocating his left elbow on sept 20 commanders coach dan quinn said after the loss that mariota is feared to have aggravated an mcl injury that sidelined him in 2022 the vet qb will undergo testing to confirm the nature of the injury mariota suffered the knee injury on a third down sack midway through the first quarter when indy defensive end laiatu latu landed on the veteran qb s right leg mariota went to the locker room and was replaced by kaliakmanis with washington leading 6 0 this was kaliakmanis first nfl regular season game appearance the 23 year old is the first qb drafted out of rutgers to attempt a pass in the nfl since the 2005 season mike mcmahon kaliakmanis is also the first rookie qb from the 2026 draft to take a regular season snap he was the eighth qb taken at no 223 overall mariota finished 3 of 4 passing for 46 yards on the day adding one rush for 35 yards kaliakmanis went 15 of 33 for 186 yards with a touchdown and an interception in relief

material_news_signals.headline: Colts vs. Commanders: Three must-know storylines for NFL Week 4 London game
material_news_signals.description: Can Indianapolis star Jonathan Taylor break out of his early-season slump? Will Marcus Mariota lead Washington to a second straight win in relief of Jayden Daniels? Jeremy Bergman provides three must-know storylines for Sunday's Colts-Commanders game in London.
material_news_signals.body_text: the european leg of the nfl s 2026 world tour kicks off this weekend in the league s most familiar foreign locale after stops in oceania and south america london is the setting for sunday morning football for the next three weeks starting with this week s colts commanders clash at tottenham hotspur stadium two of the nfl s older franchises indianapolis 1953 and washington 1932 are no strangers to the new reality of annual international football in fact both teams broke ground last season on the european continent the colts played in and won the nfl s first ever game played in berlin while the commanders participated in but lost the league s first game in spain played at madrid s bernabeu both indy and d c got off the schneid last week improving to 1 2 with surprising victories over 2025 playoff teams this sunday washington will look to break another ignominious streak winning its first international game in four tries the commanders are the only nfl franchise to play in at least three international games and not have a win 0 2 1 can the capital s club capitalize on its first win of the season with another in england or will jonathan taylor and co run over the competition overseas yet again three must know storylines 1 can taylor finally break out of early season slump jonathan taylor is as reggie jackson once coined himself the straw that stirs the drink he makes indy s offense go and has done so for the past six seasons this year he s tied for the league lead in rushing attempts through three games 66 but he s off to a career worst start in terms of efficiency taylor is averaging fewer than 4 rushing yards per attempt and has yet to record 100 ground yards in a game this season plus he s coming off the worst of his three efforts a 68 yard td less game in week 3 s slim win over houston standing in his way in week 4 a washington unit that has been surprisingly stout in run defense allowing just 246 yards through three weeks third in nfl at 3 8 yards per carry the commanders are tops in the league in run stuff percentage 25 and have allowed just five runs of 10 plus yards tied for third per next gen stats taylor was a horse in the colts international outing last season posting 244 rushing yards and 286 yards from scrimmage both international records per nfl research in indy s overtime victory over atlanta at olympiastadion with 78 rushing yards against washington taylor will be the all time leading rusher in international games in nfl history as daniel jones works his way back into form and the colts deal with health issues for wideouts alec pierce keenan allen and ashton dulin taylor needs to bring that horsepower again or indy won t be able to keep pace with jacksonville in the afc south 2 commanders sans starting qb in europe again washington is playing its second international game in as many years without its star quarterback under center after jayden daniels missed last year s madrid game with a dislocated elbow the nfl scheduled the commanders for a week 4 international bout surely the 2024 offensive rookie of the year would be healthy for that lone window slot nope daniels was ruled out for the second straight game on friday after dislocating the same left elbow in week 2 the commanders qb has foregone surgery and a stint on injured reserve and was limited in practices this week in london washington coach dan quinn said daniels return to practice was a big step that ll be little solace to the english fans who were eager to get a glimpse of the star signal caller in action on sunday lucky for washington it has an ace second stringer in fellow former no 2 pick marcus mariota the flyin hawaiian arrived in the united kingdom on a high this week after posting a throwback performance in the commanders week 3 upset of the reigning super bowl champion seahawks last sunday mariota enjoyed his first three td zero int 110 0 plus passer rating game since week 8 of 2022 and salted away the victory with a clutch read option run it was vintage stuff will it translate to week 4 against a league worst colts defense 417 3 total yards per game allowed albeit one that shut down houston last week or will a second consecutive game without daniels lead to another international defeat with mariota under center 3 can receivers take advantage of struggling dbs in a matchup featuring two down defenses it s paramount for each offense to identify areas of vulnerability to attack those soft spots lie in the secondaries of both ds meaning the offenses will aim to exploit advantages with their receivers the colts will be looking to new wr1 josh downs who took up the mantle left by the injured alec pierce and departed michael pittman downs has averaged a team high 2 4 yards per route on a 32 8 target rate in weeks 2 and 3 while the colts have mostly been without pierce and ranks 15th among qualified receivers in receiving expected points added 12 6 just below justin jefferson per next gen stats indy will hope to get him in positions against mike sainristil who has allowed a league high five touchdowns and a 142 4 passer rating when targeted through three weeks his defensive back mates jeremy reaves 154 6 rating 42 8 croe and quan martin 28 croe have fared no better opening up opportunities for tight end tyler warren meanwhile washington will look to exploit justin walley in the slot the colts primary nickelback has allowed 13 receptions on 15 targets for 213 yards and two tds in the slot the most yards allowed by any defender and 84 more than the next closest cb opponents have recorded a perfect 158 3 passer rating when targeting walley in those matchups per next gen stats that could spell a big day for the commanders top three receivers two time pro bowler terry mclaurin who s looking for his first 100 yard game in 2026 but is questionable with a balky hamstring rookie antonio williams who boasts a team high 27 2 croe and 8 7 receiving epa when targeted in the slot and veteran stefon diggs who has run a team high 44 routes out of the slot this season editor s update mclaurin is inactive for sunday s game

material_news_signals.body_text: with the 2026 nfl trade deadline set for nov 10 nfl com breaks down every trade made since the start of the regular season porter drama ends in trade to dallas date of trade oct 1 dallas receives cb joey porter grade a pittsburgh receives 2027 sixth round draft pick 2028 second round draft pick grade c the cowboys desperately needed corner help for a defense that has floundered despite the offseason upgrades i ll credit jerry jones for not sitting on his hands instead doing what we have been asking general managers to do for years be bold make moves and don t overvalue your own picks during a season we won t know if the trade pays off in the long term but the cowboys certainly improved in 2026 at his peak porter is a physical cover man who can be sticky on the outside and mirror top receivers he ll slide well into christian parker s scheme allowing dallas to play man coverage on the outside with more physicality than in the first three weeks sure he racks up some penalties but so do most cbs you ll live with the trade off for a corner with jpj s skill set that dallas didn t have to give up a premier pick until 2028 also improved its grade assuming that porter plays the cowboys get a top shelf cb for a relatively cheap up front cost jones seems to be hoping he can copy the success he had with the george pickens trade pushing off the long term talks until down the road it s a needle threading but one that could work if porter plays well dallas could extend him in the offseason use the franchise tag on the cb or let him walk and recoup a potential third round compensatory pick in 2028 possibly moving down one round in 28 and giving up a sixth rounder for a potential pro bowl player in a year when you re all in is a stellar move if porter delivers 14 games of high level play it s worth it of course if porter gets hurt or implodes this all goes for naught however if he continues on this track it is a short term win for the cowboys the long term question can be shelved i don t fault the steelers for not wanting to pay porter top cb money if he were seeking a 30 million type deal in line with christian gonzalez or devon witherspoon i would have balked too jpj is good he s not at that level trading him away relieved pittsburgh of that problem the issue i have is that it appears steelers gm omar khan either overplayed his hand or didn t anticipate porter s gumption when it came to a new deal if khan had never planned to meet the corner s contract demands he should have made a move in the spring or early summer a player of porter s caliber is worth more than a second round pick two drafts down the road the timing of the impasse reduced the compensation now the steelers are without a top corner and find themselves thin and young at the position not a good combo if things spiral in pittsburgh it s fair to wonder if khan will even be around to make that second round pick in 2028 the gm took over in 2022 and received early praise for fleecing the bears in the chase claypool trade that brought back a second rounder that pick became porter khan has now moved him for pennies on the dollar add in a string of so so drafts the pickens trade and other questionable moves and the seat in pittsburgh could get hot for khan if the steelers flounder giants trade for mccarthy after dart injury date of first rounder turned clipboard holder is a bad look all around had another club made an offer of substance before the season i believe the vikings would have moved on then given mccarthy s rough preseason however it s no surprise it took an injury to a starting qb to move the needle a fifth rounder isn t nothing and the vikings save a few pennies however the reality is they turned a first fourth and late round pick swap into 10 starts and a future fifth rounder that math isn t mathing mccarthy s poor play and injury history left the vikings with no good options for a team in win now mode minnesota didn t have time to let the 23 year old develop on his terms moving on makes sense but the vikings can t get a high grade for the compensation new york took a shot that in a new setting and in an offense keyed on the ground attack john harbaugh and his staff can do what kevin o connell couldn t i don t hate the price for a former first round quarterback who even the stingiest draft graders pegged as a day 2 selection teams use fifth rounders and later as qb dart throws all the time the giants lack of 2027 picks is of concern but they can deal with that later with jaxson dart out for the regular season after knee surgery the giants needed to make some sort of move jameis winston has shown he can hold the fort for a spell but it s a serious question if harbaugh will give the boom or bust passer enough leash for a 15 game run bringing in mccarthy at least gives the giants another alternative if winston crumbles at this stage there aren t a whole lot of other options i m not optimistic that mccarthy can turn his career around but for a fifth round pick it s worth a shot for new york
